theme: Behavioural finance: volatility ≠ loss, avoiding panic selling, staying invested
headline: Market Swings Don't Mean Your Money Disappears
body: Volatility is natural price movement. Panic selling locks in losses. Staying invested through cycles helps achieve long-term goals.
caption: Markets fluctuate daily, but temporary downturns aren't permanent losses. Investors who remain patient through volatility often see better outcomes over time. Understanding this psychology helps build resilience. #BehavioralFinance #StayInvested #MarketVolatility #InvestorMindset #LongTermWealth
